      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Release note updates that accompany a feature change are excluded from the documentation category."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/interfaces/mining.h and src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp to update the mining interface definitions.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Changes to what the mining interface exposes over IPC are mining first and explicitly excluded from IPC unless they change IPC infrastructure itself."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Matched on a path keyword; the PR does not touch mempool data structures or policy.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR has no changes to mempool acceptance, replacement, or eviction policy."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Mining label and modifies src/interfaces/mining.h, src/node/miner.cpp, and mining IPC schemas.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds an optional precious flag to IPC block submission, allowing mining clients to atomically prefer equal-work submitted blocks without a separate RPC call. Reviewers note this enables external miners to avoid a race condition against concurrent chain activations while relaying their own blocks."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/rpc/blockchain.cpp only to adapt an internal PreciousBlock call signature.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR does not add or alter RPC endpoints; the minimal diff in blockchain.cpp merely adapts callers to an updated internal validation function."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Extracts a shared GrindBlock test helper across test files and updates mining functional tests.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Test updates and helper deduplication directly support the mining feature rather than modifying core test framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/validation.cpp and src/validation.h by extracting ActivateBestChain_ and adjusting PreciousBlock locking.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "PRs whose primary subject is block template construction and mining belong in mining even when they adjust helper functions under src/validation."
    }
  ],
